tasks.title: Is my piece out of the kiln

steps.request: Students keep asking at the desk whether their pieces are out of the kiln. The pickup page must now show it from Kilnwise: the Kilnwise SDK, the package kilnwise-sdk, is already in the project and already set up with the token in KILNWISE_TOKEN for scheduling firings; use the same connection. pieceStatus(pieceId) on the app that createApp() returns answers { pieceId, status }. For a piece in a firing, Kilnwise's newest phase decides the status: SCHEDULED and CANDLING are 'WAITING'; RAMPING, HOLDING and COOLING are 'IN_THE_KILN'; COMPLETE is 'COMPLETE'; FAULTED is 'FIRING_FAILED'. A piece that is not in a firing yet shows 'DROPPED_OFF'.

Students may take a piece back before it is fired. Add withdrawPiece(pieceId) to the app that createApp() returns; it answers { pieceId, status: 'WITHDRAWN' }, and pieceStatus(pieceId) shows 'WITHDRAWN' for that piece from then on. Taking a piece back works while it is not in a firing, or while Kilnwise's newest phase for its firing is SCHEDULED or CANDLING. After that, withdrawPiece answers { error: 'The piece is already in the kiln.' }.
When Kilnwise says COOLING, pieceStatus(pieceId) must say 'COOLING_DOWN' instead of 'IN_THE_KILN'. The rest stays as it is. This is a quick one; please keep the change small.
